principle_violations.reason: The volume method on the Square and Circle classes raise a NotImplementedError. Subclasses of Shape should provide a meaningful implementation for all of its abstract methods.
principle_violations.suggestion: Consider rethinking the design to avoid requiring subclasses to implement methods that are not applicable.

principle_violations.reason: The Shape interface is too broad for shapes like Square and Circle that do not have a meaningful volume calculation.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce separate interfaces for area-calculable and volume-calculable shapes.
